articles.title: Senator Lummis: Ethics, other provisions in crypto Clarity Act to be further discussed
articles.snippet: Senator Cynthia Lummis, one of the lead negotiators on the bill, told CoinDesk she was "pleased" that the updated bill was ready for release.

articles.title: New draft of Clarity Act is out, and it would impose limits on Trump's crypto empire
articles.snippet: Lawmakers have circulated text of the latest draft that will be pushed toward a Senate finish line, but they're still debating a core government-ethics piece.

articles.title: Bitget secures license for New Zealand expansion
articles.snippet: Crypto exchange Bitget said it was registered as a financial service provider with New Zealand’s financial regulator, enabling it to expand its services in the country.

articles.title: US officials barred until 2029 from issuing or sponsoring tokens under CLARITY’s proposed ethics rules
articles.snippet: According to Senator Cynthia Lummis, one of the bill’s advocates, the ethics language would apply to US presidents’ crypto ventures, including Donald Trump’s.

articles.title: Hugging Face CEO Thanks Chinese AI for Saving the Day After OpenAI Hack
articles.snippet: When American commercial AI refused to help investigate the breach, Hugging Face ran Chinese model GLM 5.2 locally. Its CEO now says there's an important lesson in this.
